You are the planning module of a tabletop robot. Task specification: First, move the yellow_cup from the purple_zone to the cyan_zone to clear the destination. Once the purple_zone is empty, move the red_cube from its current location to the purple_zone. Success is achieved when the red_cube is on the purple_zone and the yellow_cup is on the cyan_zone.
Goals: [{"object": "red_cube", "zone": "purple_zone"}]

Current scene (from the camera):
{"table_z": 0.8, "objects": {"red_cube": {"kind": "cube", "center": [-0.076, -0.2013, 0.8199], "top_z": 0.8398, "height": 0.0398, "footprint_long": 0.0399, "footprint_short": 0.0395, "long_axis_yaw": 1.215}, "yellow_cup": {"kind": "cup", "center": [0.0355, -0.0365, 0.8353], "top_z": 0.8706, "height": 0.0706, "footprint_long": 0.0453, "footprint_short": 0.0442, "long_axis_yaw": -1.249}}, "zones": {"orange_zone": {"name": "orange_zone", "center": [-0.1153, 0.173, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0596, 0.0577]}, "cyan_zone": {"name": "cyan_zone", "center": [0.0706, 0.1617, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0595, 0.0576]}, "purple_zone": {"name": "purple_zone", "center": [0.0279, -0.0242, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0576, 0.0576]}}, "gripper": {"width": 0.0795, "closed_command": false, "holding_something": false}, "end_effector": {"position": [-0.1979, -0.0005, 1.08], "yaw": 1.499}}

Order the goals into steps. A zone that is covered by an object must be cleared first (move that
object to its own destination). Skip objects that are already resting on their target zone.
Reply with JSON only:
{"steps": [{"object": "<object name>", "zone": "<zone name>"}, ...]}
